rules.title: Unresolved FormID/reference
preconditions: Plugin or generated patch contains a FormID/FormKey reference
rules.bad_pattern: A reference cannot be resolved through the plugin master list/load order.
rules.why: The record points to a missing/incorrect form or master; xEdit documents unresolved reference errors as serious authoring defects.

detection.algorithm: Open with xEdit Check for Errors and independently resolve FormLinks through Mutagen LinkCache. Fail on unresolved targets.

fix_policy.algorithm: Identify intended source form/master, correct FormKey or master provenance, regenerate downstream output.
postconditions: xEdit error check clean for reference

evidence.notes: xEdit describes unresolved references as serious errors.

rules.title: Deleted navmesh
rules.bad_pattern: A NAVM is marked deleted instead of being repaired/replaced with a safe navmesh workflow.
rules.why: Deleted navmeshes are a high-risk Skyrim compatibility/pathing condition and require specialized handling.

detection.algorithm: Scan NAVM overrides for Deleted record flag and report source/override chain.

fix_policy.algorithm: Re-author/repair navmesh in CK-compatible workflow; do not generic undelete-and-disable NAVM.

evidence.notes: Repository rule based on xEdit/CK practice.

rules.title: NPC appearance record does not match FaceGen
rules.bad_pattern: Winning NPC_ appearance/race/weight/headpart data is inconsistent with the FaceGen assets supplied for that NPC.
rules.why: A record/FaceGen mismatch is a classic cause of dark-face/incorrect NPC appearance.

detection.algorithm: Compare winning NPC_ appearance fingerprint with chosen FaceGen provenance; verify expected mesh/tint paths exist and were generated from compatible source fields.
false_positive_exclusions: NPC intentionally uses runtime appearance system that replaces FaceGen

fix_policy.algorithm: Choose authoritative visual source, forward nonvisual fields separately, regenerate/copy matching FaceGen.

evidence.notes: EasyNPC explicitly reconciles behavior attributes with chosen face records/assets.

rules.title: Armor slots and mesh partitions disagree
rules.bad_pattern: ARMO/ARMA slot masks and NIF skin partitions do not represent the intended body coverage consistently.
rules.why: Inconsistent slots/partitions can cause invisible geometry, exposed body parts, or equipment conflicts.

detection.algorithm: Compare ARMO Biped mask, each ARMA mask/race model, and NIF partition IDs using PyNifly/Nifly.

fix_policy.algorithm: Align intended numeric Biped slots and mesh partitions; regenerate affected BodySlide/NIF outputs.

evidence.notes: PyNifly exposes Skyrim partitions/skinning for validation.

rules.title: Referenced required asset is missing
rules.bad_pattern: Resolved VFS/package contains no file at the required path.
rules.why: Missing models/textures/scripts/voice/UI files cause visible failure or runtime errors.

detection.algorithm: Build path-closure graph from plugin/NIF/config/UI references and resolve against actual deployed/VFS winners.

fix_policy.algorithm: If missing file is a declared generated output, regenerate it; otherwise block and identify missing source/dependency.

rules.title: Generated artifact is stale relative to inputs
rules.bad_pattern: One or more dependency hashes/settings/load-order inputs differ from those used to build the artifact.
rules.why: Behavior, patch, BodySlide, parallax, grass or LOD output can silently reflect an old load order or source state.

detection.algorithm: Compare current dependency graph hashes/settings against build manifest for generated artifact.

fix_policy.algorithm: Delete only derived output staging and rerun its generator plus downstream gates.

rules.title: Native plugin runtime support mismatch
preconditions: Project ships an SKSE native DLL
rules.bad_pattern: Installed/declared DLL does not support the active Skyrim executable/ABI/dependency combination.
rules.why: Native plugins operate against runtime-specific layouts/hooks and can refuse load or crash when ABI assumptions are wrong.

detection.algorithm: Compare executable version/store/VR state, SKSE, Address Library, plugin metadata and build target; inspect load log.
false_positive_exclusions: verified universal multi-runtime build covering exact runtime

fix_policy.algorithm: Install/build correct runtime target or update compatibility layer; never spoof support metadata.
postconditions: plugin loads and initializes required hooks/APIs on exact runtime

evidence.notes: CommonLibSSE-NG documents multi-runtime abstractions and runtime targeting.

rules.title: Condition patch loses CTDA semantics
rules.bad_pattern: Function/value is forwarded without preserving comparison flags, parameter interpretation, Run On, reference, parameter 3, or ordering/OR semantics.
rules.why: CTDA behavior depends on the entire encoded predicate, not just visible function name.

detection.algorithm: Normalize and compare full CTDA tuples using xEdit schema; flag partial field copies and changed OR ordering.

fix_policy.algorithm: Copy/rebuild the entire intended predicate or regenerate from typed condition model.

rules.title: Multiple OAR candidates match unexpectedly
preconditions: More than one submod can match same animation context
rules.bad_pattern: Final selection depends on priority/order not declared as intentional by the project.
rules.why: Animation can appear inconsistent when overlapping conditions are not understood.

detection.algorithm: Evaluate project OAR condition models against fixture actors/states; list all matching candidates and priority winner.

fix_policy.algorithm: Refine conditions or document priority relationship.

rules.title: Papyrus compiles but required native provider is unavailable at runtime
preconditions: A PSC/PEX calls one or more Native functions supplied by SKSE or a third-party native provider
rules.bad_pattern: Compilation succeeds because a PSC declaration exists, but the runtime DLL/provider does not load or register the declared native function.
rules.why: Papyrus compilation validates declarations, not the native implementation that must be registered by SKSE at runtime.

detection.algorithm: Build a provider map from pinned PSC declarations, identify every Native function used by project scripts, map each to its provider DLL/version, then verify the exact provider loads and a runtime smoke assertion can resolve/call the function. Fail on Papyrus '<Native> is not a valid function' or provider-load errors.

fix_policy.algorithm: Install/build the correct provider for the target runtime or remove/replace the unsupported API call; recompile and rerun native-binding smoke tests.
postconditions: provider DLL loads on exact runtime
owned Papyrus native-binding errors are zero

evidence.notes: Repository distinguishes PSC declarations from runtime native registration.
po3 provider catalog is explicitly compile-time plus runtime-provider scoped.

rules.title: Spriggit plugin round-trip changes undeclared semantics
preconditions: A plugin is serialized/deserialized through Spriggit or another text interchange representation
rules.bad_pattern: Binary -> text -> binary round-trip produces semantic record/field changes outside the declared project touch-set.
rules.why: Git-friendly representation is valuable, but serializer/deserializer coverage or translation-version differences must not silently alter plugin semantics.

detection.algorithm: Serialize the source plugin, deserialize to a second staged binary, load both with independent parsers, normalize records/FormLinks/order-insensitive collections, then compare semantic fingerprints and declared touch-set. Preserve translation package/version.
false_positive_exclusions: documented normalization differences proven semantically equivalent

fix_policy.algorithm: Pin a compatible translation package/version, isolate the differing record/field, and keep the original binary authoritative until independent parsers prove semantic equivalence.
postconditions: xEdit and Mutagen both load output

evidence.notes: Spriggit is a plugin-to-YAML/JSON round-trip tool with versioned translation packages.
Repository requires independent plugin round-trip validation.

rules.title: Declared native runtime target was not built and verified
preconditions: Project manifest declares more than one Skyrim runtime/distribution target for a native DLL
rules.bad_pattern: Release artifact is promoted after building/testing only a subset of the declared target matrix.
rules.why: CommonLib abstractions and one successful binary do not prove every runtime's relocations, ABI, metadata, imports and hooks are valid.

detection.algorithm: Compare project target matrix against CMake preset/configure/build records, output DLL hashes, metadata/import scans and runtime smoke results. Every declared target must have an explicit pass, supported universal-binary proof, or removal from the support claim.
false_positive_exclusions: single verified universal binary whose exact declared runtime coverage is independently confirmed

fix_policy.algorithm: Build and validate missing target(s), narrow the published support matrix, or supply a verified universal binary with exact runtime guards.
postconditions: all published targets have build evidence
all release-native targets have load/init evidence

evidence.notes: G09 already requires every declared target build; this rule makes incomplete matrices machine-detectable.

rules.title: Runtime harness assertion may be answering from stale or wrong game state
preconditions: Automated runtime harness communicates with a running Skyrim process through files, probe IPC, logs or detached session state
rules.bad_pattern: A test passes using stale probe/log data, another Skyrim process, an old session, or pre-trigger evidence instead of the test launch being asserted.
rules.why: Detached/headless automation can produce false positives if evidence is not session-scoped and freshness-checked.

detection.algorithm: Require unique session/build id, process identity, launch timestamp/marker, runtime/version match, evidence mtime/sequence after trigger, read-act-wait-read state transition, and—where feasible—an A/B vanilla control. Reject pre-launch or already-consumed evidence.

fix_policy.algorithm: Reset test/probe IO, stop stale sessions, rebuild isolated test profile, relaunch, and rerun the failed scenario from a clean fixture. Escalate if process/profile ownership is ambiguous.
postconditions: all evidence belongs to current session
assertion observes a post-trigger state change

evidence.notes: Skytest documents stale shared-probe/log and second-running-game failure modes and uses launch markers/session guards.
